Lakemba Nights during Ramadan will be held on Haldon Street in Lakemba every Thursday to Sunday, 6pm-2am from 27 Feb to March.

A special event clearway will also be in place on the eastern side of Mona Vale Rd in St Ives from 7am until 1.30pm, between 425 Mona Vale Rd and Kitchener St.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. AFC Asian Qualifier Round 3: Australia v Indonesia at Sydney Football Stadium. Kick-off at 8pm, finish around 10pm.

With up to 40,000 fans expected to see if Socceroos can secure their place in the FIFA 2026 World Cup, traffic will be heavier than usual on roads approaching Moore Park during the already busy evening peak.

Motorists should allow extra travel time and expect delays on roads including the Eastern Distributor, Moore Park Rd, Cleveland St, Anzac Pde and Lang Rd.

Changed traffic conditions

  • Driver Ave will be partially closed outside the stadium from 5:15pm and will reopen once crowds have safely cleared the area. 
  • No through-traffic will be available on Driver Avenue, however access to EP2 Kippax car park will be maintained via Moore Park Road and access to EP3 grass car park and drop-off areas maintained from Lang Road.  
  • Special event clearways will be in place on roads in Moore Park and surrounding areas from 3pm to 11pm on sections of Albion St, Lang Rd, Fitzroy St and Moore Park Rd, and from 6am to 11pm on Cleveland St.  

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
